title: Florida Spaceport Improvement Program
summary: FDOT's Spaceport Improvement Program describes a state capital channel administered with Space Florida and reports 48 funded infrastructure projects across the program.
key_findings: Florida maintains a dedicated state capital-improvement channel for spaceport infrastructure.
The program page reports 48 funded capital infrastructure projects.
The aggregate count does not identify current status, cost, contract, completion, acceptance, or utilization for every project.
why_it_matters: The program adds a state capital layer between Space Coast plans and the named assets needed for operations.
ftfn_relevance: Connects Florida policy to a recurring infrastructure funding channel.
Creates a discovery rail for project-level award and delivery records.
Supports comparison of plan, capital, build, acceptance, and use.
evidence_limits: The project-count statement was not independently reconstructed from project-level records in this collection.
Program participation is not a contract award, completed asset, or operating result.
Current appropriations, schedules, scope, acceptance, and utilization require named records.
